events.title: Live Jazz at Brisbane Jazz Club

events.title: Ubuntu Social

events.title: World Press Photo Exhibition 2026

events.title: Samford & Hinterland Arts Trail 2026
events.description: A self-guided arts trail through Samford Valley and the hinterland, inviting creative explorers to visit open studios, galleries, and meet local makers.

events.description: Join a creative community event or workshop at the Queensland Writers Centre, offering opportunities to connect with other writers and engage with literary topics.

events.title: Chris Botti – Live in Concert

events.title: Hatha yoga class
events.description: A Hatha yoga class organised by a local Meetup group, offering a wellness-oriented session that encourages community interaction. Expect a grounded, authentic approach to yoga practice.

events.description: Join a community bouldering night featuring informal coaching, social games on the climbing wall, and post-climb drinks at a nearby bar. This event is suitable for both beginners and regular climbers.

events.description: Join a participatory sea shanty and traditional folk song singaround hosted by The Fo’c’sle, welcoming chorus singers and instrumentalists. Lyrics sheets are provided, and the bar will be open for refreshments.

events.description: A live performance by Vidura Bandara Rajapaska, likely a comedy show or similar artistic performance, touring as 'The Paradise Gothic Tour' at The Princess Theatre.

events.title: Plants, Flavours and Food Special Guided Walk

events.description: A multi-day festival celebrating floral displays and various forms of art in Redcliffe. Expect creative exhibitions and community engagement in a vibrant festival atmosphere.

events.description: An intimate candlelight concert featuring string arrangements of popular 90s 'unplugged' hits, performed in the atmospheric setting of Saint John's Anglican Cathedral.
